subject: Pricing + Demo request — GreenLine Pay
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@greenlinepay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interested — pricing + demo (budget intent)

Hi Soojin,

I filled out the pricing CTA on the Redwood site and wanted to follow up directly. GreenLine Pay is evaluating a couple of inference providers for a payments fraud feature — we have strong latency requirements and are price-sensitive.

Rough context: 30M monthly transactions, looking at a phased rollout for fraud scoring and post-authorization assists, budget band $75k-150k/year depending on throughput.

Would love a quick demo of the platform and to see pricing at a high level before scheduling an architecture deep-dive. I'm in CEST (UTC+2) and can do afternoons my time.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Platform
GreenLine Pay
(Attachments: none)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@greenlinepay.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interested — pricing + demo (budget intent)

Hi Marta — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the context. I handle inbound demos for mid-market accounts — happy to run a focused 30-min demo showing throughput, latency profiles, and our cost levers.

Quick options:
- Wed Aug 5 — 10:30–11:00 PDT / 19:30–20:00 CEST
- Thu Aug 6 — 08:00–08:30 PDT / 17:00–17:30 CEST
- Fri Aug 7 — 11:00–11:30 PDT / 20:00–20:30 CEST

If none of those work, here’s my booking link: https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min

Also, to make the call useful, can you confirm: top 1–2 success metrics for the proof-of-concept (latency P95, cost per prediction, accuracy), and whether you need on-prem/private deployment or hosted API for now?

Cc'ing Aisha to loop in SDR coverage and to capture any initial procurement questions. I can also share a short (2-page) pricing snapshot before the call if you'd like that ahead of time.

Thanks,
Soogin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0182
(Attachments: demo-availability.ics - calendar placeholder)

Thanks, Soojin — I can do Wed Aug 5 at 19:30 CEST.

Before we lock in: can you send a high-level pricing snapshot (ballpark monthly tiers) and any notes on data residency options? We may need private deployment later, but for the POC hosted is fine if the SLA and retention meet our compliance needs.

Also, is there a short agenda you typically follow for the 30-min session?

Thanks — I'll hold that slot tentative until we confirm.
Marta

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 18:25:00 -07:00

Perfect — locking Wed Aug 5 10:30 PDT / 19:30 CEST. I just sent a calendar invite (attached) and dropped a short pricing snapshot and a mutual action plan template so procurement can see typical timelines.

Agenda (30 min):
1) 5 min — intro & goals for POC
2) 10 min — platform tour (throughput/latency, routing, batching)
3) 10 min — pricing levers & estimated unit economics for a 30M/mo workload
4) 5 min — next steps & procurement checklist

Attachments: pricing_sheet_v2.pdf (2-page snapshot), mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (procurement checklist), demo-availability.ics (calendar invite)

If you want us to include a short technical deep-dive, we can add an optional 45-min session with our infra engineer. Otherwise the 30-min work-through should be enough to decide next steps.

Thanks!
Soogin Lee
SDR, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, 345 Market St, SF
(Attachments: pricing_sheet_v2.pdf, mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx, demo-availability.ics)
